notes.title: Version 2.8.6 Update
notes.content:
Added profile backup system
 Windows version uses DirectX 11 now.

notes.title: March 29th Update
notes.content:
Added "Touch Screen" option to the Options Dialog which makes the game more playable on... touch screens!
 Fixed bug where story text was not localized
 Now includes the June 2010 DirectX Redistributable

notes.title: October 26th Update
notes.content:
Fixed bug where some Windows 10 users could not go full screen
 Use whichever windows cursors the user has configured instead of overriding with our own.

notes.title: Update Notes for March 12, 2021
notes.content:
Added Extreme Mode
 Added German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Swedish, Indonesian, Russian, and Japanese translations
